label: common_1150_system_01
text: Open the gate to the Zero Lab?

label: common_1150_system_02
text: You decided to press the button and open—

label: common_1150_rival_01
text: Huh? Why? We’re finally on the cusp of getting\ninto the lab![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_1150_friend_02
text: Look—if it’s true that a bunch of really dangerous\nPokémon might come at us, then shouldn’t we\r\nalso have [VAR 0x0101(0001)] help?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_1150_rival_02
text: Yeah, if [VAR 0x0101(0001)] were like how we first saw it\nin the Inlet Grotto, that’d be a huge help!\c\nI wanna see it battle![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_1150_botan_01
text: Uhhh... But it hasn’t even wanted to let us ride it\never since we came down to Area Zero.\c\nAnd it can’t enter its battle form in the first place![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: common_1150_friend_03
text: But it’s really strong. I know it is.\c\nIt ate all those Herba Mystica we found, too!\nWhen it really matters, I’m sure it’ll fight![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_1150_friend_04
text: And Area Zero is where it used to live...\c\nIf you bring it out of its ball now, maybe it’ll be\nable to find its family, too. Right?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_1150_rival_03
text: That’s pretty sensible by your standards, Arven![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_1150_rival_05
text: C’mon, it’ll be fine! Even if [VAR 0x0101(0001)] can’t fight,\nI’ll protect it! OK?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_1150_friend_05
text: All right! Come on, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!\c\nNow that we’ve got [VAR 0x0101(0001)] ready, it’s time to\nopen that gate![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
